title: one card for one set of places
line: three spellings of the Worcester in Montgomery County, Pennsylvania (the file's own and two more) leave three cards that offer the same two places, the same of them verified, so they are one question: the owner answers it once on any of them and every spelling takes the answer, each with its own audit row; an answer on one spelling alone (alone) leaves the others a card, and a spelling already answered is not touched by the others' answer
